versions.content: If the Dem module is requested to clear diagnostic information and the configuration parameter DemClearDTCBehavior is set to DEM_CLRRESP_- NONVOLATILE_TRIGGER , the Dem module shall return E_OK after the volatile mem- ory is cleared and clearing of the non-volatile memory is triggered.
